bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for the Fairmont Opera House.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; FAIRMONT OPERA HOUSE.

$5,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the historic Fairmont Opera House for architectural and structural repairs to maintain the building for continued use as an arts and cultural center.
